review:
Curse of the Werewolf Megaways is an early Pragmatic Play Megaways release with a full-moon horror theme. Pragmatic Play's description is brief: it highlights two features and describes the game as highly volatile.

The in-game screens advertise a maximum of 40,000x, one of the highest caps among the Pragmatic slots in our database, which fits that high-variance description. With the ever-changing Megaways reels, expect long stretches without much happening and occasional large spikes. The RTP is 96.5%. Because the official description doesn't explain the features in detail, the demo is the best way to understand how it plays before deciding whether it suits you.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
